title: Anthropic S1 Shows $80 Billion Loss This Year, WSJ Reports
text: Anthropic PBC could spend $750 billion on additional computing power in the coming years and it lost $80.7 billion in the first half of this year, according to the Wall Street Journal. The media outlet says it obtained a copy of the company's S1 filing as it prepares to go public. Romaine Bostick and Jess Menton report.  (Source: Bloomberg)
